<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events;

use App\Enums\UserRole;
use App\Models\Team;
use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

/**
 * Capsule T2 ATDD — shared event page shell adopted by a new and an existing page.
 *
 * The shell is asserted through its rendered contract (shell root, title region,
 * actions region) rather than through class/file names, so any implementation
 * that genuinely renders both pages through one shared component passes.
 *
 * Fails on HEAD: there is no shared shell contract in the rendered output and no
 * `events.overview` route.
 */
#[Group('events')]
class EventPageShellAdoptionTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    private const SHELL = 'data-testid="event-page-shell"';

    private const SHELL_TITLE = 'data-testid="event-page-shell-title"';

    private const SHELL_ACTIONS = 'data-testid="event-page-shell-actions"';

    private const SETTINGS_TABS = 'data-testid="event-settings-tabs"';

    private const EDIT_TAB = 'data-testid="event-settings-tab-edit-details"';

    /**
     * @return array{0: User, 1: Team}
     */
    private function adminWithTeam(): array
    {
        $user = $this->verifiedUser();
        $team = Team::factory()->create(['user_id' => $user->id]);
        $user->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::ADMIN->value]);
        $user->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return [$user->fresh(), $team->fresh()];
    }

    private function eventForTeam(Team $team, User $creator, EventState $state = EventState::DRAFT): Event
    {
        $event = Event::factory()
            ->inState($state)
            ->for($team)
            ->create(['created_by' => $creator->id]);

        $landing = new LandingPage(['event_id' => $event->id, 'template' => 'classic']);
        $landing->forceFill(['team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        return $event->fresh();
    }

    /** Literal path so the tests fail on behaviour (404) rather than on route resolution. */
    private function overviewUrl(Event $event): string
    {
        return '/events/'.$event->uuid.'/overview';
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC1 + AC2 — named overview route rendering through the shared shell
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function overview_page_is_reachable_at_the_named_route_and_renders_through_the_shared_shell(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $event = $this->eventForTeam($team, $admin);

        $this->assertTrue(
            Route::has('events.overview'),
            'A named route events.overview must exist.',
        );
        $this->assertSame(
            $this->overviewUrl($event),
            parse_url(route('events.overview', $event->uuid), PHP_URL_PATH),
            'events.overview must resolve to GET /events/{event:uuid}/overview.',
        );

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee(self::SHELL, false)
            ->assertSee(self::SHELL_TITLE, false)
            ->assertSee(self::SHELL_ACTIONS, false)
            ->assertSee(self::SETTINGS_TABS, false);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC3 — Landing Preview retrofitted onto the same shell, behaviour preserved
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function landing_preview_page_renders_through_the_same_shell_without_losing_its_existing_surface(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $event = $this->eventForTeam($team, $admin);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('events.landing.preview', $event->uuid))
            ->assertOk()
            // Same shared shell contract as the overview page.
            ->assertSee(self::SHELL, false)
            ->assertSee(self::SHELL_TITLE, false)
            ->assertSee(self::SHELL_ACTIONS, false)
            ->assertSee(self::SETTINGS_TABS, false)
            // Pre-existing preview behaviour other pages/tests depend on.
            ->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-page"', false)
            ->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-edit-action"', false)
            ->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-publish-action"', false);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC4 — action availability flows from the shared action model into the shell
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function both_pages_drive_action_visibility_from_the_shared_event_action_model(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $draft = $this->eventForTeam($team, $admin, EventState::DRAFT);
        $published = $this->eventForTeam($team, $admin, EventState::PUBLISHED);

        // DRAFT: the edit action is available, so the shell surfaces it.
        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($draft))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee(self::EDIT_TAB, false);

        // PUBLISHED: the shared action model disables editing. A page that did not
        // pass availability into the shell would fall back to showing it.
        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($published))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee(self::EDIT_TAB, false);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('events.landing.preview', $published->uuid))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee(self::EDIT_TAB, false);
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC5 — the overview page is read-only
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function overview_page_exposes_no_state_changing_control(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $event = $this->eventForTeam($team, $admin);

        $html = $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertDontSee('wire:submit', false)
            ->getContent();

        $this->assertDoesNotMatchRegularExpression(
            '/<form\b[^>]*action="[^"]*\/events\/'.preg_quote($event->uuid, '/').'/i',
            $html,
            'The read-only overview page must not submit to any event route.',
        );
    }

    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------
    // AC6 — same view authorization as the other event settings surfaces
    // -------------------------------------------------------------------------

    #[Test]
    public function actor_without_view_access_is_refused_from_the_overview_page(): void
    {
        [$admin, $team] = $this->adminWithTeam();
        $event = $this->eventForTeam($team, $admin);

        $billingAdmin = $this->verifiedUser();
        $billingAdmin->teams()->attach($team, ['role' => UserRole::BILLING_ADMIN->value]);
        $billingAdmin->forceFill(['current_team_id' => $team->id])->save();

        [$outsider] = $this->adminWithTeam();

        Cache::flush();

        // Billing Admin lacks events.view.team — same refusal as events.show.
        $this->actingAs($billingAdmin->fresh())
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertForbidden();

        // Cross-workspace actor never resolves the event.
        $this->actingAs($outsider)
            ->get($this->overviewUrl($event))
            ->assertNotFound();
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Livewire;

use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\LandingPreviewPayload;
use Livewire\Attributes\Locked;
use Livewire\Component;

class LandingPreview extends Component
{

    #[Locked]
    public int $eventId;

    protected EventService $eventService;

    public function boot(EventService $eventService): void
    {
        $this->eventService = $eventService;
    }

    public function mount(Event $event): void
    {
        $this->eventService->authorizeLandingFormAccess($event, authUser());

        $this->eventId = $event->getKey();
    }

    public function render(EventActionAvailability $actionAvailability): mixed
    {
        $event = $this->eventService->getById($this->eventId)->load(['landingPage', 'speakers']);
        $landing = $event->landingPage;

        return view('events::livewire.landing-preview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'previewData' => $landing === null
                ? LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, ['template' => 'classic'])
                : LandingPreviewPayload::build($event, $landing->toArray()),
            'eventActions' => $actionAvailability->for(authUser(), $event),
            'publishReady' => $this->eventService->publishReadiness($event, authUser()),
        ])
            ->extends('layouts.authenticated')
            ->section('content');
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Support;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Gate;

/**
 * Shared UI action model for event surfaces.
 *
 * Keeps capability + state + cancellation checks in one place so list/detail
 * and prepare surfaces do not drift into visible-action / denied-route UX.
 */
class EventActionAvailability
{
    /**
     * @return array<string, array{visible: bool, enabled: bool}>
     */
    public function for(User $actor, Event $event): array
    {
        $cancelled = $event->cancelled_at !== null;
        $canUpdate = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.update.team', 'events.update.global');
        $canPublish = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.publish.team', 'events.publish.global');
        $canCancel = $this->allows($actor, $event, 'events.cancel.team', 'events.cancel.global');
        $setupEditable = in_array($event->state, [EventState::DRAFT, EventState::PUBLISHED], strict: true);
        $canViewAutomations = $this->allows(
            $actor,
            $event,
            'automations.view.team',
            'automations.view.global',
        );

        return [
            'edit' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'publish' => [
                'visible' => $canPublish && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
                'enabled' => $canPublish && ! $cancelled && $event->state === EventState::DRAFT,
            ],
            'prepare' => [
                'visible' => false,
                'enabled' => false,
            ],
            'cancel' => [
                'visible' => $canCancel,
                'enabled' => $canCancel && ! $cancelled && ! in_array($event->state, [
                    EventState::LIVE,
                    EventState::ENDED,
                    EventState::SUSPENDED,
                ], strict: true),
            ],
            'manageLanding' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageRegistrationForm' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAutomations' => [
                'visible' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canViewAutomations && ! $cancelled && $setupEditable,
            ],
            'manageAudienceBoost' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
                'enabled' => $canUpdate && ! $cancelled,
            ],
            'suspend' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state !== EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'reactivate' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.suspend.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::SUSPENDED,
            ],
            'forceEnd' => [
                'visible' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global'),
                'enabled' => Gate::forUser($actor)->allows('events.force_end.global')
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && $event->state === EventState::LIVE,
            ],
            'controlRoom' => [
                'visible' => $canUpdate
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),
                'enabled' => $canUpdate
                    && ! $cancelled
                    && in_array($event->state, [
                        EventState::PUBLISHED,
                        EventState::PREPARING,
                        EventState::FAILED,
                        EventState::READY,
                        EventState::LIVE,
                    ], strict: true),
            ],
        ];
    }

    private function allows(User $actor, Event $event, string $teamCapability, string $globalCapability): bool
    {
        if (Gate::forUser($actor)->allows($globalCapability)) {
            return true;
        }

        return $actor->hasTeamPermission($event->team, $teamCapability);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace Tests\Feature\Events\E2E;

use App\Enums\PlanTier;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\EventState;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\LandingPage;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Cache;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Group;
use PHPUnit\Framework\Attributes\Test;
use Tests\Feature\Billing\Support\BillingTestFixtures;
use Tests\Feature\FeatureTestCase;

#[Group('events')]
#[Group('p1')]
class EventsBrowserRouteCoverageTest extends FeatureTestCase
{
    use BillingTestFixtures;

    protected function setUp(): void
    {
        parent::setUp();
        Cache::flush();
        $this->pinTestClock();
    }

    protected function tearDown(): void
    {
        $this->unpinTestClock();
        parent::tearDown();
    }

    #[Test]
    public function authenticated_event_builder_routes_render_without_server_errors(): void
    {
        [$admin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $event = Event::factory()
            ->inState(EventState::READY)
            ->for($admin->currentTeam)
            ->create(['created_by' => $admin->id]);

        LandingPage::factory()->for($event)->create(['team_id' => $event->team_id]);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('events.contacts.import.template'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertHeader('content-type', 'text/csv; charset=UTF-8');

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('events.control-room', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-testid="control-room-page"', false);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('events.form-config.edit', $event))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-testid="registration-form-config"', false);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('events.landing.edit', $event))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-testid="landing-setup"', false);

        $this->actingAs($admin)
            ->get(route('events.landing.preview', $event))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-testid="landing-preview-page"', false);
    }

    #[Test]
    public function public_event_support_routes_render_without_authentication(): void
    {
        [$admin] = $this->adminWithPlan(PlanTier::GROWTH);
        $event = Event::factory()
            ->inState(EventState::PUBLISHED)
            ->for($admin->currentTeam)
            ->create([
                'created_by' => $admin->id,
                'title' => 'Public route coverage event',
            ]);

        LandingPage::factory()->for($event)->create(['team_id' => $event->team_id]);

        $this->get(route('events.public.sitemap'))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee(route('events.public.show', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]), false);

        $this->get(route('events.public.registration.thank-you', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]))
            ->assertRedirect(route('events.public.show', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]));

        $this->get(route('events.public.registration.lookup', ['eventUuid' => $event->uuid]))
            ->assertOk()
            ->assertSee('data-testid="public-registration-help"', false);
    }
}

declare(strict_types=1);

namespace App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers;

use App\Models\User;
use App\Modules\Events\Models\Event;
use App\Modules\Events\Services\EventService;
use App\Modules\Events\Support\EventActionAvailability;
use Illuminate\Contracts\View\View;
use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;

/**
 * Read-only event overview surface.
 *
 * Renders through the shared Events page shell (events::components.page-shell)
 * and exposes no state-changing control: everything on the page is either text
 * or a GET link whose availability comes from EventActionAvailability.
 *
 * Access uses the same view guard as the other event settings surfaces
 * (EventService::authorizeViewAccess), on top of the `events.overview`
 * capability entry in config/route_permissions.php.
 */
final class EventOverviewController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly EventActionAvailability $eventActionAvailability,
    ) {}

    public function __invoke(Event $event): View
    {
        /** @var User $actor */
        $actor = authUser();

        $this->eventService->authorizeViewAccess($event, $actor);

        $event->load(['speakers', 'landingPage']);

        return view('events::events.overview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'eventActions' => $this->eventActionAvailability->for($actor, $event),
        ]);
    }
}

use Illuminate\Routing\Controller;

/**
 * Read-only event overview surface.
 *
 * Renders through the shared Events page shell (events::components.page-shell)
 * and exposes no state-changing control: everything on the page is either text
 * or a GET link whose availability comes from EventActionAvailability.
 *
 * Access uses the same view guard as the other event settings surfaces
 * (EventService::authorizeViewAccess), on top of the `events.overview`
 * capability entry in config/route_permissions.php.
 */
final class EventOverviewController extends Controller
{
    public function __construct(
        private readonly EventService $eventService,
        private readonly EventActionAvailability $eventActionAvailability,
    ) {}

    public function __invoke(Event $event): View
    {
        /** @var User $actor */
        $actor = authUser();

        $this->eventService->authorizeViewAccess($event, $actor);

        $event->load(['speakers', 'landingPage']);

        return view('events::events.overview', [
            'event' => $event,
            'eventActions' => $this->eventActionAvailability->for($actor, $event),
        ]);
    }
}

<?php

declare(strict_types=1);

use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Livewire\EventCopySuggestionsPage;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Livewire\EventEngagementSummaryPage;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Livewire\EventInterestSignalsPage;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Livewire\EventPostEventOverviewPage;
use App\Modules\AiCapabilities\Livewire\EventTranscriptPage;
use App\Modules\Billing\Livewire\AudienceBoostCampaignComposer;
use App\Modules\Billing\Livewire\AudienceBoostEligibilityGate;
use App\Modules\Events\Enums\AutomationType;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\AttendanceController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\AutomationConfigurationController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\AutomationUnsubscribeController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\ContactController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\ContactCsvImportController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\CrossEventReportController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\EventController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\EventExportController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\PublicLandingController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\PublicRegistrationController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\PublicSitemapController;
use App\Modules\Events\Http\Controllers\SpeakerController;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\AutomationDeliveryLogs;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\EventCustomDomainSetup;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\EventList;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\LandingPreview;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\LandingSetup;
use App\Modules\Events\Livewire\RegistrationFormConfig;
use App\Modules\Streaming\Http\Controllers\ReplayRecordingDownloadController;
use Illuminate\Support\Facades\Route;

/**
 * Story 2-1 — Events module routes.
 * Loaded by ModuleServiceProvider via glob auto-discovery.
 *
 * Capabilities are mapped in config/route_permissions.php and enforced
 * by RouteCapabilityMiddleware (alias 'route.permission'). Adding a
 * named route here without a config/route_permissions.php entry causes
 * the middleware to fail-closed (403).
 */
Route::middleware(['web'])
    ->group(function () {
        Route::get('/sitemap.xml', [PublicSitemapController::class, 'show'])
            ->name('events.public.sitemap');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}', [PublicLandingController::class, 'show'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.show');
        Route::post('/webinars/{eventUuid}/register', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'store'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.store');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}/thank-you', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'thankYou'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.thank-you');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}/calendar.ics', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'calendar'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->middleware('throttle:60,1')
            ->name('events.public.registration.calendar');
        Route::get('/webinars/{eventUuid}/registration/help', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'lookup'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.lookup');
        Route::post('/webinars/{eventUuid}/registration/help', [PublicRegistrationController::class, 'resend'])
            ->whereUuid('eventUuid')
            ->name('events.public.registration.lookup.submit');
        Route::get('/email/unsubscribe/{deliveryUuid}', [AutomationUnsubscribeController::class, 'show'])
            ->whereUuid('deliveryUuid')
            ->name('events.automation-unsubscribe.show');
        Route::post('/email/unsubscribe/{deliveryUuid}', [AutomationUnsubscribeController::class, 'confirm'])
            ->whereUuid('deliveryUuid')
            ->name('events.automation-unsubscribe.confirm');
        Route::post('/attendance/{registration}', AttendanceController::class)
            ->whereUuid('registration')
            ->middleware(['signed', 'throttle:event-attendance'])
            ->name('events.attendance.record');
    });

Route::middleware(array_filter([
    'web',
    'auth:web',
    config('jetstream.auth_session'),
    'verified',
    'workspace.active',
]))
    ->group(function () {
        Route::get('/automations/dashboard', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'index'])
            ->name('automations.index');
    });

Route::middleware(array_filter([
    'web',
    'auth:web',
    config('jetstream.auth_session'),
    'verified',
    'workspace.active',
]))
    ->prefix('events')
    ->name('events.')
    ->group(function () {
        Route::get('/', EventList::class)->name('index');
        Route::get('/create', [EventController::class, 'create'])->name('create');
        Route::get('/contacts', [ContactController::class, 'index'])->name('contacts.index');
        Route::get('/contacts/import', [ContactCsvImportController::class, 'show'])->name('contacts.import');
        Route::get('/contacts/import/template', [ContactCsvImportController::class, 'template'])->name('contacts.import.template');
        Route::post('/contacts/import', [ContactCsvImportController::class, 'store'])->name('contacts.import.store');
        Route::post('/contacts', [ContactController::class, 'store'])->name('contacts.store');
        Route::patch('/contacts/{contact:uuid}', [ContactController::class, 'update'])->name('contacts.update');
        Route::delete('/contacts/{contact:uuid}', [ContactController::class, 'archive'])->name('contacts.archive');
        Route::get('/reports/cross-event', CrossEventReportController::class)->name('reports.cross-event');
        Route::post('/', [EventController::class, 'store'])->name('store');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}', [EventController::class, 'show'])->name('show');
        // S2-2-F1 — DRAFT-only edit surface for core metadata. Backend
        // (EventMetadataService::updateMetadata) refuses non-DRAFT writes
        // regardless of the UI gate; the show page hides the link in
        // non-DRAFT states.
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/edit', [EventController::class, 'edit'])->name('edit');
        Route::patch('/{event:uuid}', [EventController::class, 'update'])->name('update');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/landing', LandingSetup::class)->name('landing.edit');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/landing/preview', LandingPreview::class)->name('landing.preview');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/form-config', RegistrationFormConfig::class)->name('form-config.edit');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/custom-domain', EventCustomDomainSetup::class)->name('custom-domain.edit');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/automations', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'show'])->name('automations.show');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/automations', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'update'])->name('automations.update');
        Route::patch('/{event:uuid}/automations/{type}/status', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'toggle'])
            ->whereIn('type', AutomationType::values())
            ->name('automations.toggle');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/automations/{type}', [AutomationConfigurationController::class, 'detail'])
            ->whereIn('type', AutomationType::values())
            ->name('automations.detail');
        // Story 4-17 — Delivery failure logs sub-page.
        // Uses plain string {event} (not :uuid model binding) so TeamScope does not
        // produce 404 for cross-team requests before authorization runs.
        // The component's typed public property is named $currentEvent (not $event) so
        // Livewire's resolveComponentProps does NOT auto-bind it via resolveRouteBinding
        // (which would apply TeamScope and return 404 for cross-team visitors).
        // mount() resolves and authorizes via EventService::resolveAndAuthorizeForDeliveryLogs.
        Route::get('/{event}/automations/delivery-logs', AutomationDeliveryLogs::class)
            ->whereUuid('event')
            ->name('automations.delivery-logs');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/prepare', [EventController::class, 'prepareRedirect'])->name('prepare');
        // E-INV S1 — read-only Audience Boost eligibility gate. Organizer-safe
        // categories only; no audience identities, reasons, or usage detail.
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/audience-boost/eligibility', AudienceBoostEligibilityGate::class)
            ->name('audience-boost.eligibility');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/audience-boost', AudienceBoostCampaignComposer::class)
            ->name('audience-boost.composer');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/exports/{type}', EventExportController::class)
            ->name('exports.show');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/recording/download', ReplayRecordingDownloadController::class)
            ->middleware('throttle:replay-download')
            ->name('recording.download');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/transcript', EventTranscriptPage::class)
            ->name('ai.transcript');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/engagement-summary', EventEngagementSummaryPage::class)
            ->name('ai.engagement-summary');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/post-event-overview', EventPostEventOverviewPage::class)
            ->name('ai.post-event-overview');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/interest-signals', EventInterestSignalsPage::class)
            ->name('ai.interest-signals');
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/ai/copy-suggestions', EventCopySuggestionsPage::class)
            ->name('ai.copy-suggestions');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/publish', [EventController::class, 'publish'])->name('publish');
        // Story 2-5 — cancel route was missing from routes.php; registered in Story 2-4 R1.
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/cancel', [EventController::class, 'cancel'])->name('cancel');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/suspend', [EventController::class, 'suspend'])->name('suspend');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/reactivate', [EventController::class, 'reactivate'])->name('reactivate');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/force-end', [EventController::class, 'forceEnd'])->name('force-end');

        // Story 2-2 — Speaker CRUD
        Route::get('/{event:uuid}/speakers', [SpeakerController::class, 'index'])->name('speakers.index');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/speakers', [SpeakerController::class, 'store'])->name('speakers.store');
        Route::post('/{event:uuid}/speakers/reorder', [SpeakerController::class, 'reorder'])->name('speakers.reorder');
        Route::patch('/{event:uuid}/speakers/{speaker:uuid}', [SpeakerController::class, 'update'])->name('speakers.update');
        Route::delete('/{event:uuid}/speakers/{speaker:uuid}', [SpeakerController::class, 'destroy'])->name('speakers.destroy');
    });
